name: Beta-phenylmethamphetamine
summary: β-Phenylmethamphetamine (N,α-dimethyl-β-phenyl-phenethylamine) is a potent and long lasting stimulant drug.

uses.en: It is a research chemical with no medical use, known from laboratory studies of amphetamine structures.
uses.zh: 它是研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，僅見於安非他命結構的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究化学品，没有医疗用途，仅见于安非他命结构的实验室研究。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Long acting stimulants of this kind can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety and, with heavy use, paranoia and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。這類長效興奮劑可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮，大量使用時還會出現妄想與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。这类长效兴奋剂可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、失眠、焦虑，大量使用时还会出现妄想与精神病。

fact.en: It is methamphetamine with a whole extra phenyl ring on the side chain, which makes it a much larger molecule than most stimulants of this family.
fact.zh: 它是在甲基安非他命的側鏈上多加一整個苯環的產物，因此分子比這個家族中多數興奮劑都大得多。
fact.zhHans: 它是在甲基安非他命的侧链上多加一整个苯环的产物，因此分子比这个家族中多数兴奋剂都大得多。
